videos.title: I Gave My AI Agent My IDE. Here's What Changed.
videos.description:
Give your AI agent the same tools you use. Try JetBrains IDEs free 👉 https://jb.gg/IDEs-JetBrains
📖 Why we still need an IDE (JetBrains blog): https://jb.gg/6d1jwb

Some developers say AI killed the IDE. The agent writes the code and runs the tests, so why not just live in the terminal? On small projects that works fine. But in the terminal your agent is mostly coding blind: it searches through text and hopes it lands on the right thing. Your IDE actually understands the code. So I tested what happens when the agent gets the same tools you do, first on a small Python project and then on a real production codebase of about 220,000 lines.

🧠 Want to LEARN how to build AI agents that actually get things done? Start here: https://aiagentbuilders.co/pro

Most of us give it away.

In this clip, Jay Shetty shares the simple morning routine he tried himself. Every step is backed by research on how your brain works. And none of them take much time.

videos.title: Why Forgiving Toxic Family Can Set You Back | Dr. Ramani
videos.description:
People think you cut off family over one bad moment. It's never one moment. It's the last of 1,500 others.

In this clip, Dr. Ramani Durvasula and Jay Shetty talk about how you know it's time to cut off a toxic family member. Dr. Ramani explains the "natural experiment." It can show you the truth about a relationship without you saying a word.

She opens up about her own no contact decision, one that took 40 years to make. She shares why the people who walk away are often the ones who tried hardest to fix things. And she explains what to say when the whole family starts pushing back.

Learn the one sign that shows someone can really change. And learn why forgiveness isn't always the healthy choice.
